steps.text: During adolescence the body sweats more, so personal hygiene matters more than ever. Let's build a daily routine.
Tap the healthy habits to add them — start with “Daily Bath/Shower”.
Add the rest: wash hands frequently, wash your face, and wear clean clothes daily. These keep you fresh and prevent infections.
Simple daily habits — bathing, clean clothes, and washing hands — keep you healthy and confident. Stay clean, stay healthy!

coach.mission: Build a daily personal-hygiene routine for adolescence.
whenStuck: Tap each good habit to add it to your routine.
Think about what keeps the body clean every day.
whenWrong: More sweating means daily bathing, clean clothes, and hand-washing matter.
Good hygiene prevents body odour and infections.
whenCorrect: Right — that's a healthy daily hygiene habit.
Good — small daily habits keep you clean and healthy.
coach.done: You've built a healthy hygiene routine. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
